render_recipes.default: Canonical RGBA at native UI size.
render_recipes.hover: Same art; UI-owned focus/hover boundary, no new raster.
render_recipes.selected: Same art; ink selection ring outside canonical bounds, preserve anchor.
render_recipes.disabled: Same art; UI-owned dimming plus unavailable text; do not mutate source PNG.
render_recipes.danger: Canonical semantic icon plus independent severity_danger glyph and localized danger label.
render_recipes.warning: Canonical semantic icon plus severity_warning glyph and localized warning label.
render_recipes.notice: Canonical semantic icon plus severity_notice glyph and localized notice label.

semantic_variants: See catalogue.json variant_ids; these are authored PNGs.
localization: No text baked into art; KO/EN share canonical PNG.
implementation_status: No rendering code or live binding changed.
